title: 下雨天的野餐
text: {umbrella:enter}{girl:enter}{girl:go to sand}蘿拉和{dog:enter}{dog:go to sand}小狗在沙灘上野餐。{girl:face happy}{dog:live wag-tail}忽然……滴。答。{canvas:rain 0.8 18s}{sfx:rain}滴滴答答！下西北雨了！{girl:face surprised}{girl:says}[excited]「狗狗，快！躲到遮陽傘下面！」 {girl:go under umbrella}{dog:go under umbrella}{girl:live crouch hold}他們一起擠進紅白條紋的大遮陽傘底下。{umbrella:pulse}雨點打在傘頂上，答、答、答。{girl:face happy}好舒服喔！{dog:live play-bow}可是小狗坐不住。{dog:go to girl right}牠一溜煙衝進雨裡，{dog:face happy}繞呀繞、轉圈圈。然後牠跑回來，{dog:go under umbrella}全身濕答答的，{dog:live shake}就在蘿拉旁邊，用力甩、甩、甩！{girl:face happy}{girl:says}[laughs]「狗狗！我現在比雨還要濕啦！」 [short pause]{canvas:rain stop}後來，雨停了。{umbrella:live spin}遮陽傘輕輕轉了一圈，把最後幾滴雨甩掉。{canvas:rainbow 14s}[gasps]你看，海灣上出現了一道彩虹。{girl:face happy}{dog:face happy}{girl:says}[softly]「淋濕也值得了。」 {dog:hearts}
